messages:
maria: quick sync — the console's per-model cost card is misleading for customers who rely on prefetch/cache. they see negative 'net token cost' lines and assume billing bug. can we make cache savings and amortized cost clearer? :thinking:
sam: +1. i've seen a few support tickets. two quick ideas: (1) surface 'cache-credit policy' used for the window, (2) show sample requests contributing to the amortized savings.
jin: if we expose the policy we need an internal API that returns the attribution window + seed samples. i sketched an API:```GET /internal/v1/costs/attribution?model=gpt-like-3&window=24h```response:```{\n  "model":"gpt-like-3",\n  "window":"24h",\n  "prefetch_savings_tokens":123456,\n  "amortized_credit_per_invocation":0.0123,\n  "sample_request_ids":["r_abc", "r_def"]\n}```we should avoid sending raw sample prompts to the console. redact or hash.
olivia: sampling/scrubbing is important. also quota calc uses gross tokens today which confuses teams that expect net-to-quota. policy: do we keep quotas on gross or net? product needs to decide, engineering can add a toggle flag in the UI.
am: (typo) sorry.
sam: leaning towards quotas on gross for predictability; billing on net after cache credits. UX idea: show two sparklines stacked — gross burn and net burn — with a small legend and tooltip that explains "cache credited X tokens". minimal change.
alex: +1 on stacked sparklines. also propose an 'explain this number' flyout with a 3-step trace: route -> model variant -> cache attribution. tiny mock: "Trace: route /chat -> model gpt-like-3-mq -> prefetch hit rate 18% -> credit 0.0123 tok/inv". helps support debug.
jin: implementation note: our attribution job emits per-agg keys every minute. we can surface the latest agg and embed a sample set id rather than requests. then another internal endpoint can return hashed sample ids for on-demand inspection. avoids storing PII in console.
maria: good — reg redaction rules. product: can we get a final decision on quota = gross vs net by EOD? if product prefers gross -> we change UI labels, if net -> update quota enforcement.
olivia: product preference: gross for quotas, billing net. i'll ping finance for confirm and update by 15:00 PT.
sam: one more: chart sampling. large tenants have noisy spikes; we should add a 1-in-N sampling toggle with estimated error margin. current backend supports approximate_count() already. front-end needs a confidence badge.
alex: agree on confidence badge (like 95% +/- 0.8%). UX will show it as subtle gray text next to the number.
deploy-bot: pipeline: cost-service/attribution v2 -> staging deployed (build 2489). https://ci.internal/repo/2489 :rocket:
maria: ok next steps: jin to spec internal endpoints + redaction, sam to wire stacked sparklines, alex to design flyout, olivia to confirm product/finance call. i'll do a short writeup and add to the rollout checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: thread about console UX + internal API for cache attribution and quotas; includes API sketch and decisions pending on quota semantics
